jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL professional design plate of FIVE DISTINCT MECHANICAL TIGERS, the independent beast components of FIVE-BEAST CROWN from the novel 万机残响. Exactly five complete FOUR-LEGGED adult tiger-shaped machines, no humanoids or combined robot yet.
References 1 and 2 establish the project's mature ink-and-paint mechanical illustration: powerful convincing sculptural volumes, fine dark linework, layered painted armor, visible serious joints and restrained wear. Reference 3 and 4 show official Japanese beast-combiner products only as lessons in bold beast masses, identifiable heads/paws and regional color. Do not reproduce these specific robot designs or their toy-plastic finish. Do not put horses, dinosaurs, birds or lions with manes into this team: these are five original TIGER machines.

Landscape warm-paper concept sheet, two beasts in the upper row and three below, all separate, complete tails and all four paws visible or clearly connected. Big readable objects, no text, option letters, numbers, labels, logos, arrows, frames, scenery or humans. They are not a row of five copied cats with different paint. Every tiger must have a different body silhouette, head profile, paw anatomy, back structure and tail type, while belonging to the same mature design family. No cute kitten proportions, round baby faces, giant cartoon eyes, soft bubble paws or plush-like shells. Serious poised mechanical predators with deep-set narrow sensor eyes and forceful hard-edged jaws.

TOP LEFT — CENTRAL COMMAND TIGER: the largest by body volume, about 1.5 times a limb beast. Deep charcoal / gunmetal body, bronze-gold armor borders and sparse pale-steel transitions. Very high broad chest and shoulders, square strong neck, powerful compact torso, large sharply squared muzzle with restrained fang shapes, broad forehead plate with two short swept temples and small angular tiger ears, NO lion mane. Four powerful pillar-like jointed legs and large flared armored paws. A pair of substantial longitudinal coupling RAILS on the back, an equally visible protected belly rail opening, and a compact segmented counterweight tail. This torso will become the combined giant's chest/waist; its imposing tiger head will form the central chest symbol, and the new humanoid crown head will emerge behind its neck. Make this a regal guardian beast through proportion and authority, not a crown hat or jewelry.
TOP RIGHT — RED BREACHER TIGER: red/carmine large armor zones, black inner structure and silver jaws. Shorter low-slung front-heavy body, huge forequarters and very thick front paws, broad short muzzle with powerful hinged lower jaw and TWO clearly engineered clamping canine blades. Relatively compact rear legs; low layered back armor, short heavy segmented tail with a square counterweight tip. It becomes a crushing forearm, so the jaw and foreleg blocks are its visual identity. Not a red copy of the central tiger.
BOTTOM LEFT — GREEN RELAY / SCOUT TIGER: deep forest / emerald green, gunmetal and narrow warm-bronze bands. Long flexible torso and waist, wedge-shaped narrow head with long cheek sensor rails and small flat ear fins, athletic long jointed legs and slimmer precise clawed paws. Two low flat directional sensor blades lie along the upper back; long articulated whip-like relay tail with a protected rectangular end. It must remain a powerful adult-sized tiger whose total body mass can balance the red arm, not a tiny cat. The jaw is a precise narrow gripping clamp. Distinct stretched running silhouette, not spiky fantasy armor.
BOTTOM CENTER — BLUE TRACTION TIGER: rich cobalt/naval blue body, charcoal joints and silver small planes. Broad rectangular sealed back and side buoyancy armor, medium-low shoulders, long heavy belly, very large WIDE FLAT armored paws with strongly separated plate-like toes. Its head is a long broad wedge with sealed brow, wide cheek blocks and no antlers. All four feet are massive stable traction pads. A short flat articulated tail folds close to its back, visibly different from the green whip. Sealed but heavily articulated aquatic/rough-ground recovery beast, not a fish or a reptile. This becomes one entire thick lower leg/boot.
BOTTOM RIGHT — YELLOW QUARRY TIGER: saturated ochre/yellow armor with charcoal and limited silver. Lowest and widest beast, thick slab shoulders, blocky flared brow shields, deep rectangular mechanical jaw, heavy compact rear quarters, broad paired layered spine plates. Four especially chunky clawed climbing feet with wedge toes and obvious load-bearing ankle joints. Its tail is a short articulated stabilizer bar ending in a flat gripping heel, not the central segmented tail. This becomes the other lower leg/boot; the blue and yellow bodies are similar overall volume and length but clearly DIFFERENT in shape and role.

Mechanical consistency: exactly four legs per beast; articulated shoulders, elbows/knees and ankles; real paw-claw plates; belly clearance; strong hinges and rails sized for the body. Tiger ears stay compact and angular, not bunny ears. Color covers whole designed shells with clear black/metal transitions; no random rainbow pieces, no dominant ivory shell and no glowing neon stripes. The red and green are arm-sized, blue and yellow are bulkier leg-sized, central is the large body. Parts can unfold later, but no unexplained loose armor floating nearby.
Render sophisticated contemporary Japanese mecha concept art with the depth and detail control of reference 1/2. Confident large forms, sparse meaningful seams, painted-steel wear selectively at paw edges and couplings, intense but controlled character. This is a new candidate design, not a production blueprint.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a professional ORIGINAL design plate of FIVE DISTINCT ELECTROMAGNETIC COMBAT VEHICLES, the independent components of the novel 万机残响's ELECTROMAGNETIC FIVE team. This is a DIFFERENT team from the five four-legged tiger beasts. Here all five are VEHICLES with their own protected pilot cockpit. No quadruped animals, no humanoid robot forms and no combined giant in this image.
Reference 1 and 2 are mature project ink-and-paint illustration style and volume only. Reference 3 (Combattler V official product) and 4 (Superion official product) are lessons in coherent vivid color zones, clean lengthwise mecha forms, plane-derived structures and distinctive central silhouette. Do not copy their characters, exact silhouette or plastic toy surface. Draw original designed technology at the sophisticated adult mechanical art level of references 1/2.

Landscape warm-paper development plate. Two vehicles upper row and three lower row, all five fully inside canvas, generous spacing, slight front-three-quarter views showing each complete silhouette. Different vehicle functions are instantly distinguishable at thumbnail size. Dark recessed glass cockpits, no transparent pilot portraits. No letters, labels, numbers, logos, text, diagrams, arrows, background scenery, extra units, small duplicate views or loose floating parts.
Large planar painted armor, strong primary colors with gunmetal and silver structural transitions, restrained meaningful bronze/yellow electromagnetic hardware. Serious heroic 1970s/1990s Japanese combiner spirit rendered in mature contemporary ink. No cutesy rounded animals, tiny chibi vehicles, ordinary modern trucks, white gadget shells or unconnected greebles.

TOP LEFT — RED COMMAND / ASSAULT JET (future head and upper chest):
A compact muscular crimson-red arrowhead strike aircraft with a short powerful wedge nose, dark central cockpit, broad swept folding wing roots and twin short stabilizers. The front armored prow has a subtle mechanical TIGER-BROW structure: two sharply angled sensor/intake recesses, a central narrow ridge and restrained cheek/canine-like intake strakes. It remains unmistakably a jet, not a tiger head with wings. Deep navy undersides and silver thin wing leading edges. The strong red wing-root pair can later rotate into the giant's two major chest plates; the central nose housing can fold under the chest. A concealed compact head cavity is suggested behind the cockpit, not shown. No long spindly plane.
TOP RIGHT — WHITE / PALE-STEEL TWIN-BOOM INTERCEPTOR (future shoulder bridge and TWO arms):
One aircraft, ONE protected central dark cockpit, two very substantial parallel longitudinal engine / weapon-control nacelles joined by a stout center bridge; folding short white outer wings. Pearl-white main shell, dark navy undersides and cool blue broad inset bands. Each front nacelle has a restrained faceted tiger-cheek/hinged jaw-shaped protective block, two different functional claw recesses but matching arm mass. Nacelles are thick enough to become genuine powerful forearms/upper arms; their strong longitudinal axis is legible. The bridge remains intact to protect the single cockpit. Avoid a giant animal head, two separate jets or a thin drone.
BOTTOM LEFT — DEEP BLUE ELECTROMAGNETIC REACTOR CRAWLER (future waist / hip / sword housing):
Low broad navy-blue tracked armored vehicle, two chunky dark continuous treads, an armored central cockpit, one large protected annular electromagnetic rotary assembly with bronze-gold segmented ring visible in the body, and a substantial squared tail section. Its identity is a compact mobile power station, not an ordinary tank; NO huge gun turret. Thick nested rotary rings and lower frame will form the giant's freely rotating waist. Along one side, a long closed deep-blue rectangular scabbard housing visibly stores the segmented electromagnetic sword, with a silver edge only barely visible in its recessed slot. Strong low belly and side access panels, not a glowing reactor orb.
BOTTOM CENTER — YELLOW HEAVY BORE / LANDING VEHICLE (future one complete lower leg and foot):
Ochre-yellow armored forward-drilling carrier on two thick short dark track units, long heavy narrow central body, ONE large tapered silver / gunmetal screw drill at the front, protected yellow shoulder cowls and a small dark cockpit located above and behind the drill. Two folding ground braces flank the hull. Solid rear block and dark underbody, elongated rectangular armor plates and distinct obvious knee/heel articulation seams. Its mass and length should match the teal leg vehicle, not a tiny drill accessory. It is a heavily engineered drill craft, not a cute construction toy and not a tiger on wheels.
BOTTOM RIGHT — DEEP TEAL AMPHIBIOUS RESCUE / LANDING CRAFT (future the other complete lower leg and foot):
A thick elongated deep-teal / sea-green armored rescue lander with TWO broad enclosed side pontoons, one central recessed dark canopy and a wide silver-gray sloping front landing bow. Powerful dark rear thruster housings with protective fins, folded landing pads along the lower flank and side rescue-grip recesses. Similar overall volume and length to the yellow drill craft but a different rounded-wedge bow and flat broad rear deck. A subtle angular feline brow only in the forward armor geometry, no literal tiger face. No drill, no tanks, no fins like an ornamental fish. Stout water/air landing vehicle with real boot-sized hull mass.

All five use compatible dark structural coupling sockets and broad industrial hinges in a small number of clear places, one pilot cockpit each, and visibly distinct overall proportions. Do not force all five to have the same nose, canopy or wheel type. The final combined robot will use red chest, white long arms, dark blue rotary waist, yellow and teal entire lower legs, so paint the vehicles as large coherent blocks rather than colorful patchwork. Preserve these exact shapes as the source for a later combined image.
High-quality fine dark linework, deep mechanical occlusion, controlled painted-metal shading, a little wear on major edges. Attractive large-scale mecha sculpture and serious design, not 3D product rendering, flat cel icons, or invented engineering-certification graphics.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create the ORIGINAL combined humanoid hero FIVE-BEAST CROWN from EXACTLY the five mechanical tigers in reference image 1. That freshly designed component sheet is the binding source for every beast head, paw, armor profile, color, rail and tail. The two rows in that component plate are a display arrangement, not a declaration of physical scale. Preserve the identity and distinctive shapes of each beast.
Reference image 2 sets the project's mature illustrated mechanical depth, fine ink, material wear and sculptural power. References 3 and 4 (official Daizyujin / Dairenoh products) are only lessons in a commanding beast-warrior silhouette, concentrated chest symbol, small serious helmet, shoulder/waist contrast and huge lower-leg/foot mass. Do NOT copy their helmet, face, green orb, exact chest pattern, toy texture, sword or markings. This robot is not Starfire; do not give it a row of chest lamps or rescue-truck body.

Composition: landscape original mecha design plate on quiet warm-paper ivory. ONE magnificent full-body front-three-quarter hero occupies the left/center about 75 percent, all toes, hands and crest fully in frame; slightly low viewpoint, stable wide powerful stance, one blue boot forward. A smaller full-body REAR three-quarter study occupies the right to show the folded paws, tails, dorsal rails and back of the same five-component body. No extra tigers, no loose parts, no weapon, no text, letter, number, logo, arrows, labels, captions or decorative frames.

CORE AESTHETIC:
A regal brutal-but-controlled armored BEAST GENERAL, muscular broad shoulders, deep barrel chest, dark narrow waist, strong compact hips, comparatively quiet short metal upper thighs, huge angular lower legs and boots, long powerful animal gauntlets. This should be an iconic adult collector robot, not five cute tiger toys glued together. Use clear big color masses: charcoal/bronze-gold body; red one arm, deep green the other; cobalt/naval blue one entire lower leg and ochre yellow the other. Black/gunmetal joints and narrow bronze/steel structural boundaries unify the colors. Preserve the red arm's crushing bulk and the green arm's longer precise form; they need not be identical mirrored gauntlets, but both are substantial and useful. No generic silver human face, no universal V-shaped breastplate, no spiky fantasy wings.

CENTRAL BLACK/GOLD COMMAND TIGER -> BODY:
Its imposing gunmetal tiger head becomes the SINGLE dominant chest emblem, tightly integrated into a large bronze-bordered black breastplate: long squared muzzle, deep-set amber tiger eyes, strong silver jaw edge, short angular ears and brow armor remain recognizable. The tiger mouth is closed, not a cartoon smile or a gaping cockpit. Its actual broad torso rises behind that chest into a deep strong ribcage, abdomen and hip frame. The body is NOT five flat pasted animal heads; the central tiger's curved shoulder masses and torso plates create sculptural chest depth.
The beast's four paws fold into the two upper-shoulder/back buttresses and two hip armor guards, with their claw plates still visible in the rear study, not unexplained extra arms or legs.
Its TWO long dorsal coupling rails fold vertically down the back as an explicit spine / back-lock frame. Its segmented black/gold tail wraps in a single purposeful arc behind the waist as a stowed counterweight.
An ORIGINAL compact humanoid commander head emerges just above the tiger brow: a full enclosed DARK GUNMETAL helmet and faceplate, narrow steady jade/amber visor, sculpted bronze angular jaw guard, broad gold brow band, and THREE short sturdy crown-like armor projections with a strong center. No copied Voltron face, no silver human nose or mouth, no long V antenna. Crown through architecture and hierarchy, not jewelry.

RED BREACHER TIGER -> ONE ARM:
The red beast's low broad body unfolds into a thick forearm and strong upper arm, its bulky front paw plates folding to wrist guards and hind legs locking along the elbow/rear-arm structure. The exact red broad tiger head and TWO engineered canine clamp blades form a FUNCTIONAL wrist/gauntlet jaw. Show this red jaw partly OPEN so a large object could be clamped between upper and lower jaw; no little human fist pasted onto the nose. Its short heavy tail nests along the outer rear forearm as a counterweight rail. Bold red shoulder and gauntlet planes with black joints, not covered by invented white armor.
GREEN SCOUT TIGER -> OTHER ARM:
Its long torso forms a slimmer but powerful extended forearm and articulated upper arm. Narrow wedge tiger head, sensor cheek rails, two low relay blades and green armor remain distinct. The four paw/claw mechanisms fold into a precise three-finger GRASPING HAND framed by the tiger jaw armor, allowing this arm to grip while the red jaw clamps. Show fingers clearly connected. The long relay tail coils ONCE along the rear arm/back sensor spine and ends in its original rectangular sensor tip, not a free floating cable or a second tail. Do not thicken this arm into a red-arm clone; its length and precise hand are the contrast.

BLUE TRACTION TIGER -> ONE THICK LOWER LEG / BOOT:
Its long sealed rectangular body becomes the broad blue shin with armored flotation/traction sidewalls. Its broad tiger head and two front paws join the large wide wedge boot; tiger muzzle lies along the front toe upper surface, not pointing straight down into the ground. Rear paws fold to calf/ankle bracing and the short flat tail closes a posterior calf cover. Silver toe plates form stable traction toes. Preserve its blue broad flat surfaces.
YELLOW QUARRY TIGER -> OTHER THICK LOWER LEG / BOOT:
Its low slab body forms a different ochre-yellow calf and shin, with its paired layered back plates becoming the outer shin shield. Broad brow and powerful mechanical jaw form the yellow boot upper; huge climbing paw plates build the toe edges and heel structure. Its short stabilizer-bar tail folds down the heel as a visible rear support. Match the blue leg's assembled standing height and basic mass but keep the yellow leg's quarry-specific heavy wedge shapes.
Both boots must lie flat and carry weight, no tiny feet and no precarious animal heads balancing on fang tips. The five tiger heads are each accounted for: central chest, red gauntlet, green wrist armor, blue boot, yellow boot. Keep recognizable anatomy without clutter.

REAR STUDY:
The same robot seen from back-three-quarter, with correctly swapped sides from the new camera. Show central twin dorsal rails, black tail at waist, folded spare paws at back/hips, red and green tails in their specified compact locations, and the back of blue/yellow calf parts. It must be a real reverse view of the main design, not an alternate robot with different horns, extra colors or extra components.

Rendering: rich mature hand-drawn Japanese mecha concept illustration, strong large designed planes, fine variable dark ink, convincing structural overlap and deep occlusion, restrained painted-metal edge wear. Clear limb proportions and readable color zoning. Keep surface detailing concentrated around meaningful transformation joints; leave big armor faces quiet. No glossy plastic product lighting, no flat vector look, no soft rounded child robot, no glowing effects. A proud original beast king with tool-like jaws and paws that visually explain its fighting character.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create the ORIGINAL ELECTROMAGNETIC FIVE combined humanoid hero, using EXACTLY the five vehicle designs in reference image 1 as the source. This is the next plate after those five vehicles, not a redesign of them. Preserve their exact colors, prow/wing/nacelle shapes, cockpit shells, electromagnetic ring, drill and teal pontoons. Reference 2 is the project's mature painted mechanical illustration standard. Reference 3 Combattler V and reference 4 Superion are composition/proportion lessons only: clean lengthwise forms, strong large red/white/navy color regions, meaningful aircraft surfaces and a poised heroic overall silhouette. Do not copy their head, exact face, chest logo, toy finish, antenna crown or weapon.

This is a DIFFERENT team from the five beast-crown robots and the rescue Starfire team. It is a TALLER, more vertical ELECTROMAGNETIC SWORDSMAN, with disciplined shape and an agile rotating waist. No giant tiger head pasted onto its chest, no animal-headed feet, no row of rescue lamps, no black/gold beast-king torso.

Landscape warm-paper concept plate. One LARGE full-body three-quarter hero left/center, all feet and the complete sword visible, head high with a slight shoulder/waist twist, one leg forward, a composed capable duelist rather than a generic straight toy stand. On the right a SMALL full-body back-three-quarter study shows aircraft-wing folding and distinct rear leg equipment. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, arrows, diagram frames, loose component pictures, extra robots or scenery.

OVERALL SHAPE:
Compact stern closed helmet, high long shoulders, muscular white angular upper/lower arms, an imposing broad red upper chest, visibly narrower deep-blue rotary waist, strong blue hips and quiet pale-steel upper thighs, then two VERY SUBSTANTIAL but lengthwise lower legs and large boots, one ochre yellow and one deep teal. Broad shoulders, real chest depth, tapered middle, powerful wrists. Longer torso/upper-leg rhythm than the stockier rescue or beast giant but still massive enough to be a combiner. Big planes and longer axes create speed and dignity, not thin fragile limbs.

RED COMMAND JET -> HEAD / UPPER CHEST:
Its two broad red wing-root shells fold into TWO angular sweeping chest plates, with dark-blue narrow central separation and silver leading edges; the red plates form a single recognizable breastplate shape like a broad folded ceremonial blade, not a generic V decal. The jet's actual wedge prow turns downward as a compact central sternum guard, retaining its tiger-brow-like intake recesses as abstract functional geometry. Its cockpit shell remains protected at upper back/behind the head, not cut in two.
The new helmet deploys from the jet's neck housing: dark navy fully enclosed faceplate with one narrow AMBER horizontal eye slit, RED short central vertical forehead blade, WHITE broad flat temple/cheek rails, a squared dark jaw. No silver human mouth/nose, no twin long yellow antenna like Superion, no Gundam V. The helmet is a compact aerodynamic command instrument with a distinct original silhouette.

WHITE TWIN-BOOM INTERCEPTOR -> SHOULDER BRIDGE / BOTH ARMS:
Its one central cockpit bridge remains intact across the upper back under the neck. Its two thick white nacelles unfold down into the two broad-shouldered long arms. Preserve their blue broad bands and squared faceted prow housings at the forearms; the hinged jaw-like protective blocks become white gauntlet collars around black mechanical hands, not literal furry tiger heads. Both hands are real connected strong articulated fingers, able to grip the sword. The outer wings fold along the rear upper-arm/shoulder edges as short blade-like fins, creating a clean tall shoulder silhouette. Keep nacelle engine sections in the back of the arms, no extra anonymous arm armor.

BLUE ELECTROMAGNETIC CRAWLER -> WAIST / HIPS / SWORD:
The actual bronze-gold annular electromagnetic ring sits around a clear dark-blue ROTATING waist mechanism between chest and hip, compact and strong, with continuous circular bearing visible at one side. The cockpit remains enclosed in the back waist housing. The lower crawler frame forms the pelvis; tread assemblies fold behind hip/rear-thigh armor rather than vanishing or becoming ornamental tiny wheels. The long blue side scabbard housing is now secured diagonally along the back/hip.
A long broad electromagnetic sword has been DRAWN from that housing: dark blue grip, solid angular hand guard, a pale-steel segmented straight blade with narrow bronze joints and a deep-blue central structural spine. A real physical blade, no neon light saber, no flaming aura. Hold it diagonally to the side with the complete tip within canvas, poised for a controlled sweeping cut. Design the scabbard opening and visible segmentation so it is not a weapon appearing from nothing.

YELLOW BORE VEHICLE -> ONE LOWER LEG / FOOT:
Its long yellow armored hull forms the shin; the tracked body and rear block create the wide solid boot and heel. The single large silver screw drill rotates and folds UPWARD along the OUTER/REAR calf in a protected recess, point higher than the ankle and not touching the ground; it is clearly the same drill, not duplicated into two small drills. Its side braces fold along the ankle/heel. Yellow broad armor planes, dark treads at the outside/back, cockpit glass protected high on the calf side. The boot has a proper flat sole and designed toe, no standing on the drill point.
TEAL AMPHIBIOUS LANDER -> OTHER LOWER LEG / FOOT:
Its paired broad enclosed pontoons become the major teal shin sidewalls, its wide silver-gray sloping bow becomes a broad stable wedge boot, its large rear thruster housings remain at the rear calf, and its folded landing pads become heel supports. Same single cockpit protected on the calf side. Preserve the specific teal vessel's bow, pontoons and fin geometry. No yellow drill copied onto this leg. Match overall leg height and weight-bearing stance with the yellow leg despite different shape.

COLOR:
Crimson/red concentrated upper chest, WHITE dominant shoulders and forearms with blue bands, NAVY rotating middle and hips, pale-steel quiet thighs, YELLOW one entire lower leg and TEAL the other. Bronze/gold ring details are purposeful small accents. This is regional color composition; not a white robot sprinkled with colorful plates. Large clean red/white shapes must survive at thumbnail size. The rear study uses the same exact source parts, sides correct for the viewpoint, no bonus engines or extra wings.

RENDER:
Sophisticated hand-drawn Japanese mechanical illustration, fine variable dark ink and steel panel drawing, deep believable volume/overlap/occlusion, restrained paint edge chips, moderately vivid heroic colors. Keep big uninterrupted armor planes and put details at joints and functional devices. Do not mechanically flatten it to two shadow colors; do not make photoreal glossy toy plastic, soft pastel robot or high-greeble military kitbash. Hands, hips and stance express a confident mobile swordsman. This is a new project design proposal, not a manufacturer product photo or a claim of verified physical transformation.
